QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Seeking Lost Memories
QuestInfo.0: The Memory Keeper insists that you return to where your adventure began to find what you've forgotten... The beginning of one's journey. Perhaps that fight with Archon was the beginning of yours.
QuestInfo.1: The Memory Keeper insists that you return to where your adventure began to find what you've forgotten... The beginning of one's journey. Perhaps that fight with Archon was the beginning of yours.
QuestInfo.2: You returned to your home in Helia for the first time in a while. No one was inside, but it was still full of memories. The start of your adventure wasn't in darkness and shadow, but there--with your family.
